result.title: EDAGoat: An EDA-Aware Agent for Project-Level GPU Optimization
result.summary: GPU acceleration has transformed electronic design automation (EDA), yet further improving expert-engineered GPU tools still demands substantial manual effort. Automating this work calls for coding agents that can trace bottlenecks across host and device code while preserving correctness and design quality. We introduce EDAGoat, to our knowledge the first EDA-aware GPU optimization agent for this task. Its optimization enhancement (OE) mode guides edits with four cross-project GPU optimization patterns. Its mandatory validation (MV) mode requires the agent to test the edited program against the EDA constraints its changes could affect. Our benchmark covers five GPU EDA projects across four task families and 55 circuit inputs, measuring complete-solve runtime and verifying the resulting designs. Each configuration runs three independent searches per project. A search qualifies only if its solver passes correctness and design-quality checks on all public and hidden inputs. With DeepSeek, generic prompting qualifies in 7 of 15 searches and OE in 6 of 15, despite a higher best speedup on four projects. Adding MV raises this to 13 of 15 and, on every project, exceeds both generic baselines in mean and best speedup and OE in mean speedup; the geometric mean of per-project mean speedups rises from 1.11x (1.36x with OE) to 1.53x. With GPT-6 Astra, EDAGoat qualifies in all 15 searches and improves both speedup metrics over generic prompting on every project, lifting the same geometric mean from 1.26x to 1.57x. These results show that agents can use EDA knowledge to find further speedups in expert-tuned tools while preserving design correctness and quality, establishing EDA-aware GPU optimization as a new direction for agent research.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EDAGoat，一个面向项目级 GPU EDA 优化的编码智能体：用四类跨项目优化模式引导代码修改，并以强制验证模式检查编辑是否触犯相关 EDA 约束，在五个项目上评测完整求解时间及设计正确性与质量。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「先验证再采纳」的编辑—检验循环及以全部公开/隐藏输入通过为合格标准，可能为 LVR 中的证据获取、候选轨迹筛选与停止决策提供参照，但领域相距较远，迁移价值有待核查。
